evidence: deepseek uses "color[v] = 3 - color[u]"; gpt-oss declares "0 or 1 for bipartition"; glm performs the same alternating BFS coloring
affordance_in_statement: A legacy controller accepts a link between a machine with mode x and a machine with mode y if and only if the base-10 representation of the integer 3^{x+y} ends with the digit 7.
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving way to remove this reduction: for x,y in {1,2}, the rule accepts exactly x+y=3, so every link intrinsically requires opposite modes. Rewording the arithmetic condition or presenting it as a table would only hide, not remove, the bipartite structure.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Reduces every accepted link to an opposite-mode constraint and solves the graph by BFS bipartite coloring.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The controller condition accepts exactly 3^(1+2) and 3^(2+1), both ending in 7.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses a two-color graph bipartition, then selects the lexicographically smaller orientation.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The controller condition accepts exactly links whose endpoint modes sum to 3.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Alternates colors across every edge with BFS, treating a same-color edge as impossible.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The controller condition forces every linked pair to have one mode 1 and one mode 2.

common_affordance: The suffix condition reduces the entire task to testing whether the input graph is bipartite and choosing the lexicographically smaller bipartition orientation.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its visible approach begins by enumerating valid mode pairs, but the submitted implementation mishandled the resulting pair relation or its use in the graph assignment; it did not correctly enforce that every edge must be a (1,2) or (2,1) edge.

recommended_edit: No single semantics-preserving edit can defeat all survivors: the examples and the stated mode set force the accepted relation to be exactly the opposite-mode relation. A genuinely defeating edit would have to change the controller compatibility relation so it is no longer equivalent to x+y=3, which changes the task.
